finding.title: Valid transient sourceId extension-prefix pairs become ambiguous in M3.3 source artifact lookup
finding.cause: Transient admission accepts sourceIds such as Course and Course.pdf. With PDF source bytes M3.3 packages them as sources/Course.pdf and sources/Course.pdf.pdf. M3.3 verification locates each source using names that start with sources/<sourceId>.; therefore lookup for Course matches both artifacts and rejects the bundle as non-unique.
finding.contractImpact: Issue #348 requires every transient-PASS sourceId to remain M3.2/M3.3 binding-valid and safely materializable. Two independently admitted valid sourceIds can form a valid source set that cannot cross M3.3 solely because source identity is recovered from a filename prefix rather than an exact manifest binding.
reproduction: Course and Course.pdf both satisfy transient.SOURCE_ID and independently yield PASS_TRANSIENT_SOURCE_ADMISSION_V1 for exact PDF bytes
prepare_review_bundle self-verification raises 'source artifact path for Course is not unique'
